messages.author: 409dfe1554e9c224
messages.subject: facet_wrap modification
parts:
Hi,

> myPlot + facet_wrap(~ myFactor)

leads - given the 5 levels in "myFactor" - to a layout like so

A B C
D E

Is there a straight forward way to modify this to look like this

A B
C D E

Moreover: can the legend be placed such that it ("L") is using the
empty facet?

A B L
C D E

Thanks for any hints, Joh

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: RE: facet_wrap modification
parts:
Johannes,

Add the missing levels to your factor and use geom_blank.

library(ggplot2)
dataset <- data.frame(A = rnorm(1000), B = rnorm(1000), Code =
factor(rep(LETTERS[1:5], 200)))
ggplot(dataset, aes(x = A, y = B)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~Code)
dataset$Code2 <- factor(dataset$Code, levels = c("A", "B", "L", "C",
"D", "E"))
ggplot(dataset, aes(x = A, y = B)) + geom_point() + geom_blank(data =
data.frame(A = 0, B = 0, Code2 = "L")) + facet_wrap(~Code2)

HTH,

THierry
